name: kneeling back of hand wrist stretch
description: A kneeling stretch with the backs of the hands on the floor. It opens the top of the wrists and the forearm extensors.
instructions: Kneel on all fours and place the backs of your hands on the floor, fingers pointing toward your knees.
Keep your hands under your shoulders and your arms straight.
Slowly shift your hips back until you feel the top of the wrists stretch.
Keep the pressure light and breathe slowly.
